real_name: Arshad Pappu (real name kept in film)
real_life_notes: Real Lyari gangster who led the rival faction against Rehman Dakait's People's Aman Committee. Arshad Pappu and Rehman Dakait were the two poles of Lyari's gang war from 2004-2013. Arshad Pappu was kidnapped and beheaded in 2013 — the Lyari underworld's most notorious killing of that era. Jamali's collusion with Pappu (exposed by Yalina in the film) is rooted in real PPP-linked politicians playing both Lyari factions against each other for votes.
film_role: Film 1 — rival gang leader. The scene where Yalina Jamali reveals Jameel Jamali's collusion with Pappu against Dakait is the film's key political intelligence revelation — Jamali is hedging between both criminal factions to maintain political control.
objective: Control Lyari territory; displace Rehman Dakait; leverage political patronage from PPP faction
real_death: Beheaded 2013 — attributed to rival gang faction. Lyari's most notorious killing of that period.
